example:
**EXAMPLE**:
This is what the **EXAMPLE** Keyword does.
dice:
**+/-DICE**:
Dice that are added to Success Rolls. If the Keyword applies to a Weapon, the dice are only added to Success Rolls for Attacks made with it.
injury dice:
**+/-INJURY DICE**:
Dice that are added to Injury Rolls
injury modifier:
**+/-INJURY MODIFIER**:
Modifiers that are applied to the result of an Injury Roll. If the Keyword applies to a weapon, the modifier is only added to Injury rolls for Attacks made with that weapon
action:
**ACTION**:
An activity a model can carry out when it is Activated. Common **ACTIONS** include Move, Dash, Shoot, and Fight
ammunition:
**AMMUNITION**:
If a model has a piece of Battlekit with this Keyword, it will use it in the next game that it takes part in. When the model is deployed, say which Ranged Weapon the Battlekit will be used for. It gains the (**KEYWORD**) until the end of the game. The Ranged Weapon you choose cannot already have the **BLAST**, **FIRE**, **GAS**, or **SHRAPNEL** Keywords, and cannot have more than one type of **AMMUNITION**.
armour piercing:
**ARMOUR PIERCING**:
A Weapon with this Keyword reduces the total -INJURY MODIFIER from its **ARMOUR CHARACTERISTIC** , and/or any Armour or Shields it has by 1, to a minimum of 0. For example, if a target has Standard Armour and a Trench Shield, the **-INJURY MODIFIER** would be lowered from -2 to -1.
artificial:
**ARTIFICIAL**:
This model is not of natural biological origin, but instead is constructed of non-organic elements
assault:
**ASSAULT**:
Ranged Attacks made by Weapons with this Keyword do not prevent a model from taking a Charge or Fight *ACTION* during the same Activation
automatic:
**AUTOMATIC (X)**:
When you take a Shoot **ACTION** and choose a Weapon with this Keyword to make a Ranged Attack, you can take a number of Ranged Attacks with this Weapon equal to X, one after another. The Attacks can target different models if desired, as long as they are all within 6" of eachother. Resolve each attack one at a time using steps 2 to 6 of the Ranged Attack Sequence. Any **BLOOD MARKERS** or *BLESSING MARKERS** that are spent only modify the Injury Roll for the Ranged Attack they are spent on.
black grail:
**BLACK GRAIL**:
This model is part of the Cult of the Black Grail Faction.
blast:
**BLAST (X")**:
A Ranged Weapon with **BLAST (X")** has a blast radius in inches equal to X (including vertically!). When you make an attack with the Weapon, you must pick a target for the attack. The target can either be an enemy model or visable point on the battlefield or on a terrain peice; whichever you choose must be within the attacking models Line of Sight and the Weapon's range. If the Success Roll for the attack is a Failure, the attack misses and nothing happens unless the weapon also has the *SCATTER* Keyword. If the Success Roll for the attack is a Success or Critical Success, every model that has a Line of Sight to the target of the attack and which is within the Weapon's blast radius is hit. In addition, friendly models that are within 1" of and enemy model that aws hit by the blast radius are also hit. Measure the blast radius from the centre of the target model's base, or the centre of the visible point you picked, to the closest point on the otehr model's base. Make an Injury Roll for every model that was hit. If you roll a Critical Success, only add the extra *INJURY DICE* to the rll for a model if it was chosen as the target of the attack.
blessed:
**BLESSED (X)**:
When you deploy a model with this Keyword for the first time in a game, place a number of blessing markers beside the model equal to X.
blessing marker:
**BLESSING MARKER**:
The model is under the influence of a supernatural or chemical enhancement that provides temporary benefits
